US Median Home Prices Hit ‘All-Time High’ of $396,500
Homes that are overpriced by even a little are ‘likely to sit on the market,’ said a real estate agent.

The median sales price of a home in the United States hit a record high of $396,500 for the four weeks ending on June 15, with buyers now in a favorable position to negotiate prices, real estate brokerage Redfin said in a June 20
statement
.
“While the median sale price is at an all-time high, it’s roughly $26,000 lower than the median asking price of $422,238,” the company stated.
